description: Use it when the user wants the fonts a site uses, their files and licenses, or free fonts that match a site's type. Reads one page of a website in a headless browser and saves its fonts in one folder: which font draws its headings, body text, buttons and code, every font file the page loads, how each one is licensed, and the closest free font for each one that is not free. FONTS.md is the file to read first, fonts.css is for pages, with a variable for each role, and fonts.json for tools. The license of each font is written next to it so the user can decide what to use. It reads only the page at url, so a font used only on another page needs a run on that page, and a page that answers with an error gets no kit. For a whole brand kit with logos and colors, use make_brand_kit instead. The fonts playbook (makersmcp_playbook) has the whole job. (easyfontkit 0.1.5, on this machine.)

files.description: Save every font file the page loads in files/ (default true). Set to false to read the font files without saving them; fonts.css then loads none of the site's own files.

out_dir.description: Folder to save into, absolute or relative to /tmp/churn-hnvpfmca. Default: easyfontkit-<host>, where <host> is the site's host without www or the port. A run replaces what an earlier run of this tool left there once it has ended well, and one that fails or is canceled leaves it as it was: give each version its own out_dir. The folder must be empty or hold an earlier run of this tool: any other folder stops it.

timeout_seconds.description: Give up after this many seconds (default 120). When a role shows a system font where the site's own was expected, its fonts may load late: try 240.

url.description: The page whose fonts to read, like https://linear.app. Only that page is read, and fonts can differ between pages, so give the one whose look is needed.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result, counted from the start of the call, before returning a job_id to wait on. Some clients end a call after 60 or 240 seconds; 45 is safe in all of them.

name: make_font_kit

continued.description: True when this call continued the job an identical call started, instead of starting another.

docs.description: The notes the text shows, and where each one is.

expires_at.description: When the download links stop working.

url.description: Where to download the file, when the job ran on a server.

folder.description: Where the kit saved its files.

last_line.description: What the kit was doing last.

next.description: What to do next, as the Next line says.

passed.description: For checks: whether the check passed.

title: Fonts of a website
